topic: World's Largest Companies by Market Cap

interpretations.label: Market Capitalization (Equity Value)
interpretations.description: Total dollar value of a company's outstanding shares of stock
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Share price multiplied by total number of outstanding shares, expressed in USD
caveats: Subject to exchange rate fluctuations when converted to USD

interpretations.label: Enterprise Value (EV)
interpretations.description: Comprehensive measure of a company's total value including debt and cash
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Market cap plus total debt, preferred stock, and minority interest minus cash and cash equivalents, expressed in USD
caveats: Accounts for debt structure which market cap ignores

knownRisks: Varying fiscal year-end dates across global entities
Corporate restructurings, spin-offs, and ticker changes over a 27-year span
